column2: This policy applies to every AI system we build, buy or embed, and to everyone who uses them on our behalf.
We use AI lawfully, transparently and with human accountability; we do not deploy systems for prohibited practices.
Staff may use approved AI tools for listed purposes; confidential or personal data may only be entered into approved systems.
New AI uses are recorded in the inventory and approved by the AI review group before production.
Every production system has a named owner, a human override and monitored metrics.
Vendors complete the due-diligence questionnaire; contracts allocate obligations.
AI incidents are reported within one working day and handled under the incident checklist.
This policy and the risk register are reviewed annually and after any serious incident.
